# Security policy

Rustia is experimental and has no supported release yet. Untrusted scripts need
explicit resource limits and an embedding environment appropriate to the host.
Source availability does not establish a security certification or support SLA.

Do not post exploit details, secrets or private host data in a public issue or
pull request. Use **Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability** in this
repository to send a private report to the maintainers. Include the revision,
embedding configuration, expected behavior and a small reproduction where safe.

If the private reporting button is unavailable, open an issue asking only for
a private security contact. Do not include the vulnerability details there.
Responses and fixes depend on maintainer availability; no response deadline or
bug bounty is promised.
